newsitem.title: UK: Dennis deal earnings enhancing - Ladbroke.
newsitem.headline: Dennis deal earnings enhancing - Ladbroke.

text.p: The acquisition of the A R Dennis betting shops by Ladbroke Group should be earnings enhancing from the first year, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Ladbroke bought the 114 betting shops from the privately-owned company for 31.3 million pounds.
The Ladbroke Racing division will have 1,925 outlets after the acquisition of the London and south-east England chain.
It will have to divest three shops in order to satisfy monopoly concerns, the spokesman added.

Ladbroke's betting division was badly hit by the launch of the National Lottery in November 1994 but a reduction in duty and the introduction of cash prize machines to high street stores has improved the situation.
"The prospects for the industry are brighter than for a number of years," the spokesman added.
However, competition from the lottery is about to intensify with the launch this Wednesday of a second weekly draw.
